caption: Closest reference yet to the actual spec. Take: warm gold-amber light living in the cracks and seams rather than sitting on the surface, the chest gem reading as the single hero light, flat-topped angular pauldrons that break at a hard outer corner, and fine crack texture across every stone facet. Diverge: ours runs warm granite grey rather than charcoal, the hip coverage is a scale kilt rather than flat tassets (canon), and ours carries a much stronger chest-to-waist taper — this figure is knightly and even rather than tank-class.

Faceted stone plate with heavy shoulder mass and a layered scale skirt. Take: the shattered-granite facet language, the sheer shoulder volume, and the way the skirt breaks into overlapping plates rather than reading as fabric. Diverge: our shoulders sit on a cantilever with a visible shadow gap instead of sloping into the torso, and ours carry topaz seam light — this reference is monochrome.
